checks: Shift and Ctrl toggle multiple clips without changing the project
Focused Space selects clips without playing; editor Space still plays
Empty-lane marquee selects intersected tracks without seeking or recording edits
Group move preserves timing offsets and one undo restores every member
Compatible cross-track drag preserves relative track offsets
Locked or incompatible destinations reject the entire group
Escape and pointercancel restore the full selection without adding history
Group copy and paste keep animation and create independent IDs
Group duplication and ripple deletion each use one undo step
Select-all and batch delete preserve locked clips
